name: GodHands
long_description:
Analysts keep working real cases in the tools they already use. GodHands learns each decision and the reason behind it, then builds agents that work the next alerts the same way and keep learning as the rules change. There are no integrations and no specs to write: agents go live in weeks.

At BlitzQuant, a high-frequency trading firm, agents now resolve 90% of live risk alerts without human review, and the team handles 3x the alerts with the same people.

We start with fintech operations, then expand to every operations team.
one_liner: Agents that automate operations by watching employees
